title: 20章：放下一切去寻你
content_zh:
云裳望着清粼粼的夷水，蹲下身，将右手探入河水里，沉浸在梦一样的波光涟漪里。

    “你一定要去找他？”刘金玉黑着脸，看着眼前戏水的俏丽佳人，可是眸子中却是怎么也掩藏不住的懊恼。

    他不明白，那个混了吧唧的张荼，到底有着怎样的魅力，可以让云裳这么清冷的女子都为之神魂颠倒。

    哪怕自己在他们关系降到冰点的时候趁虚而入，也不过是得到了名义上的对象，两年来，任何实质性的一步都没有跨出。

    可是想到自己这两年竟然忍受着那个男人的存在，自己也真是昏了头。

    云苍遥遥看着河边的两人，神情冷漠，平心而论，不是刘金玉做得不好，可是就像是八字不合一般，自己发自内心的讨厌这个姐夫，而对于张荼，却是十分投缘。

    或许，很多时候，很多事情的出场顺序是很重要的。

    不是你不够好，而是你的出场顺序不对。

    若是先遇到刘金玉，或许就是另外一个局面了，可是人生，没有如果。

    云裳机械地拨弄着水花，双目无神地盯着粼粼水光，她忘不掉那一日他的冷漠，就像是陌生人一般，这不是她想要的。

    可是她，究竟想要什么。

    “嗯。”

    半晌之后，云裳从鼻腔深处憋出来了一声嗯。

    刘金玉的面上暴躁之色一闪而过，愤怒地来回踱步，胸中似有惊雷在炸裂，面上瞬间赤红，可是最终出口的却是。

    “你还会回来么？”

    刘金玉觉得自己真的快疯了，自己怎么可以如此的低声下气，如此卑微到尘埃里，可是却依然换不回一颗心？

    听到刘金玉的问话，云裳不断拨弄水花的手也停了一下，看到暴躁的刘金玉，不远处的云苍身形也不由自主地绷紧，自己的姐姐虽然做得不对，可是有些事情还是要说明白得好，当断则断来的好些。

    但是他要是胆敢伤害自己的姐姐，那是不可以的，当初他趁着二人矛盾，死缠烂打的追求，自己姐姐赌气似的在一起，本就是一笔糊涂账。

    自己还记得那一日，一向冷静的姐姐，失去了平日的淡定，异常的焦躁不安，直到拨通了荼哥的电话。

    “喂，是我，我想谈恋爱了，要不要在一起。”

    手机那一端传来了张荼惊讶且无奈的声音：“多少年了，早干嘛去了你。”

    云裳似是急了，声音里带上了哭腔：“你确定你要她不要我！”

    张荼说道：“不是我要她不要你，你明明先出现，可是你不要我的。结果现在你给我来这么一出，你反射弧够长的啊你，你真的就是汽车撞墙你知道拐了；股票涨起来你知道买了；犯错误判刑了你知道悔改了，我都不知道该怎么说你了。”

    张荼的话不是很多，一般开始喋喋不休的时候，那是心里不一般的恼火，听到连串的话语，云苍也是想起自己以前惹怒张荼的模样，喋喋不休地说教，比老妈还老妈。

    “那你别后悔！”

    撂下这句狠话之后，云裳便是愤愤挂了电话，随后几天后，晚饭期间，云裳就宣布了自己恋爱的消息，自己到现在都记得，在知道云裳的对象不是张荼的时候，自己爸妈眼中那难以掩饰的失望。
content_en:
Yun Shang looked at the sparkling Yi Shui, squatted down, put his right hand into the river, and immersed himself in the ripples of light like a dream.

    "Do you have to go find him?" Liu Jinyu looked at the pretty lady playing in the water with a dark face, but there was annoyance that could not be hidden in his eyes.

    He didn't understand what kind of charm Zhang Tu had, who could make such a cold woman like Yun Shang fascinated by him.

    Even if I took advantage of the situation when their relationship was at a freezing point, I would only get the person in name only. In the past two years, no substantial step has been taken.

    But when I think about how I have endured that man's presence in the past two years, I feel really dizzy.

    Yun Cang looked at the two people by the river from a distance, with an indifferent expression. To be fair, it wasn't that Liu Jinyu did a bad job, but it was like they were incompatible. He hated this brother-in-law from the bottom of his heart, but he was very attracted to Zhang Tu.

    Perhaps, many times, the order of appearance of many things is very important.

    It's not that you're not good enough, it's that your appearance order is wrong.

    If he had met Liu Jinyu first, it might have been a different situation, but there are no ifs in life.

    Yun Shang fiddled with the water splashes mechanically, staring at the sparkling water with dull eyes. She could not forget his indifference that day, as if he was a stranger. This was not what she wanted.

    But what exactly does she want?

    "Yeah."

    After a while, Yun Shang suppressed a hmm from deep in her nose.

    An angry look flashed across Liu Jinyu's face, and he paced back and forth angrily. Thunder seemed to be exploding in his chest, and his face turned red for an instant, but what he finally said was.

    "Will you come back?"

    Liu Jinyu felt that he was really going crazy. How could he be so humble and humble to the dust, but still couldn't change his heart?

    Hearing Liu Jinyu's question, Yun Shang's hand that was constantly playing with the water stopped for a moment. Seeing the irritable Liu Jinyu, Yun Cang's figure not far away involuntarily tensed up. Although his sister did something wrong, some things are better said clearly, and it is better to break things off.

    But if he dares to hurt his sister, that's not allowed. He took advantage of the conflict between the two and pursued her relentlessly, and his sister got together out of spite. It was a mess.

    I still remember that day, my sister, who had always been calm, lost her usual calmness and became extremely restless until she dialed Brother Tu's number.

    "Hey, it's me. I want to fall in love. Do you want to be together?"

    Zhang Tu's surprised and helpless voice came from the other end of the phone: "It's been so many years, why have I gone to you?"

    Yun Shang seemed anxious, with a cry in her voice: "Are you sure you want her not me?"

    Zhang Tu said: "It's not that I asked her not to want you. You showed up first, but you didn't want me. But now you do this to me, your reflex arc is long enough, you are really like a car hitting a wall and you know you have turned; when the stock rises, you know you bought it; when you made a mistake and was sentenced, you know you repented. I don't even know what to say to you."

    Zhang Tu didn't talk much. Usually when he started chattering, it was because he was feeling unusually annoyed. Hearing the series of words, Yun Cang also remembered how he had angered Zhang Tu in the past. He kept preaching and was more like a mother than a mother.

    "Then don't regret it!"

    After saying these cruel words, Yun Shang hung up the phone angrily. A few days later, during dinner, Yun Shang announced the news of her relationship. She still remembers the unconcealable disappointment in her parents' eyes when they found out that Yun Shang's partner was not Zhang Tu.
title_en: Chapter 20: Let go of everything to find you
